test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

Energy : Joule
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

The unit of Energy is Joule.

Similarly,

The unit of Current is Ampere.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Current : Ampere".**
